name: Name
loginNeeded: Log in to save your farms and log daily observations.
searchPlace: Search for a town or village
noFarms: No farms yet. Add your first farm above.
adviceOffline: Crop advice needs the AgriCast API. Start the backend and reload.
disclaimer: AgriCast is planning support, not professional agronomic advice. Forecasts are uncertain and calendars are indicative, not guaranteed planting dates.
saveHint: Log in or create an account, then add your farm and crop under My Farm to track growth, reminders and alerts.
outlookText: Seasonal outlooks are not shown here. A 7-day forecast cannot predict rainfall months ahead. Read the Kenya Meteorological Department's seasonal outlook at meteo.go.ke.
noCalendar: No planting calendar is available for this crop in this county yet. AgriCast does not guess planting dates. Ask your county extension officer.
broader: No entry for this exact county. Showing information for a broader region. It may not match your area.
refParams: General reference values (approximate, not yet reviewed)
feedback: Choose a crop and a county to see its calendar.
inside: Your planting date is inside a calendar window.
outside: Your planting date is outside the calendar window(s). That can be fine for your field. Check with your extension officer.
noEntryWindow: No calendar entry to compare with yet.
rainCheck: Your rain gauge vs modelled rain
rainCheckHint: Log rainfall in observations to compare it with modelled rainfall for your farm.
offlineSaved: Saved on this device. It will sync when you are online.
smsOpt: Send me alert SMS (your network's rates may apply)
sampleData: SAMPLE DATA for testing only. These dates are placeholders, not agronomic information.
noSources: No calendar sources have been loaded yet. Import real records first (see docs/__sources.md).
noCrops: No crops are available yet. Start the API (docker compose up) and reload the page.
apiOffline: Frontend-only mode: the AgriCast API is not running. Weather, general guidance, crop facts and the water balance still work. The planting calendar, rainfall onset, accounts and farm records need the backend.
draftNotesWarning: These notes are a team draft and have not been checked against a source yet. Confirm them with your county extension officer before acting.
noNotes: No growing notes for this crop yet.
listedScope: The source does not give dates by county. It names your county in the areas of the agro-ecological zones below. Zones differ across a county, so check which zone your farm is in (ask your county extension officer).
zoneFilter: Your agro-ecological zone (if you know it)
allZones: All zones listed for this county
